import_column_duration_description: Duration in seconds. A whole number: 900 is 15 minutes, 45 is a short act under a minute.

import_guide_columns: All five columns are required, but cells in {#col}type{/col}, {#col}number{/col} and {#col}nomination_title{/col} can be left empty. An act row only needs {#col}title{/col} and {#col}duration{/col}; a block row only needs {#col}type{/col} and {#col}title{/col}. Extra columns are ignored.
import_guide_intro: The schedule is read from the first sheet of the workbook. The first row holds the column headers; below it, one row per act and one for the start of each block. Column names are written in Latin letters exactly as in the list below; the column order doesn't matter.
import_guide_replaces: {#strong}The file fully replaces the schedule.{/strong} Acts are matched by the {#col}number{/col} column: matching ones are updated, and any not in the file are deleted. Rows without a number have nothing to match against, so they are added again every time. Blocks are matched by name. The row order sets the order in the schedule.
